dataset.name: Deform360
dataset.source_episode_selection: the five quality-passing source observations from the already published 001-rope protocol

scientific_question: Does a persistent reduced-physics posterior abducted from one real interaction improve prediction under a distinct recorded intervention on the same physical object?

semantics.persistent_latent: index of the frozen 200-member reduced-rope dynamics bank
semantics.abduction: generalized-Bayes posterior from factual-A future Chamfer scores only
semantics.intervention: a different source interaction B with B's measured controller trajectory
semantics.event_specific_contact: B's contact schedule, node, and offset; never copied from A
semantics.prediction: posterior predictive mixture of the candidate rollouts under B
semantics.real_counterfactual_boundary: A and B are separate physical executions. This is a logged cross-intervention surrogate, not individual-level real counterfactual ground truth.

posterior.temperature_rule: max(0.5 mm, factual-only median absolute deviation of candidate Chamfer scores)

primary_pairing.partner_rule: for each challenge, choose one distinct factual episode by minimum SHA-256 of protocol_id:primary-pair:challenge:factual

controls.uniform_physics: same 200 candidate rollouts under B with uniform weights
controls.candidate_id_permuted: same factual posterior weight multiset cyclically shifted by a nonzero deterministic SHA-derived candidate-ID offset before B prediction
controls.persistence: B prefix endpoint repeated over the B future

promotion_rule: If the source gate passes, register a separate target-closed multi-object protocol before opening any new candidate object's held-out episode. If the gate fails, retain the negative source result and do not open a new target.
